name: Aeonx Digital Technology Ltd
summary: Aeonx Digital Technology Limited, an Indian company founded in 1992 and headquartered in Mumbai, serves as a global purveyor of software and cloud technology. Operating internationally, this firm, a subsidiary of Aura Alkalies And Chemicals Private Limited, adopted its current name in December 2023, having previously been known as Ashok Alco-Chem Limited. The company offers an extensive portfolio of business solutions, prominently featuring SAP-centric services like RISE with SAP for implementation, SAP SuccessFactors for human capital management, SAP Ariba for connection solutions, and SAP BTP to leverage business capabilities. Their expertise also extends to Big Data analytics for delivering actionable insights, SAP Mobility for enterprise applications, DevOps for integrating software development and IT operations, and comprehensive Application Maintenance Services (AMS). Aeonx has also developed its own suite of proprietary "X" products: OrderX for online order facilitation, SupplierX as a subscription-based vendor portal, SignX for digital signature and approval processes, DriveX for secure file storage and retrieval, Xpense for expense management, ScanX for transferring QR-scanned data to SAP, AttendX as a cloud-based SAAS solution for tracking contractual labor attendance, and AceX for daily reporting and business intelligence. In the cloud domain, Aeonx provides a variety of solutions, including SAP and Microsoft deployments on AWS, disaster recovery services, application modernization, Internet of Things (IoT) implementations, machine learning solutions, industrial-specific offerings, and managed services. Furthermore, the company delivers a broad spectrum of professional services such as management consulting, supply chain optimization, cloud database solutions, ERP support, custom application development, cloud and DevOps advisory, system integration, and educational training programs. They also handle implementation, ongoing support, system migration, innovation initiatives, and staffing services. Intriguingly, Aeonx also partakes in mineral trading. Their client base is diverse, encompassing industries like manufacturing, mining and minerals, logistics, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, oil and gas, telecommunications, and retail.
